cases.note: Typed evaluation facts retain exact target, evaluator, policy, evidence, and measurement identity; the projection stores those source references.
Learned output remains advisory, proposals require explicit submission, governance fields are not representable, and deterministic/human authority outranks advisory model-judge signals.
The in-memory property keeps raw fact identity and evidence independent from a derived projection; database deletion/recovery evidence remains a runtime limitation.
Full QualificationBundle identity, skipped-MUST failure, environment/build evidence, and database-backed runtime gates require the qualification harness and isolated PostgreSQL environment.

known_limitations: This artifact is a deterministic benchmark/property fixture and traceability map, not a QualificationBundle.
The fixture does not claim that the COGNITION profile is qualified; blocked cases remain non-passing evidence.
Database-backed RLS, migration runtime evidence, deletion recovery, and cross-session storage behavior require an isolated PostgreSQL environment.
The property suite checks observable invariants and provenance rather than exact nondeterministic LLM wording or model quality.
